guide.title: Li Li's Overview
guide.text:
Li Li is a Healer that provides a high amount of
sustain healing but a low amount of burst healing,
something that makes her particularly good in prolonged team fights
and bad in other scenarios, unless she can get some value out of her
Blind to mitigate a considerable amount of damage.

guide.title: Li Li's Strengths and Weaknesses
guide.text:
Strengths
High sustain healing
Ability to Blind
Weaknesses
No hard crowd control
Lack of burst healing
Her healing Abilities prioritize Heroes low on Health
Poor waveclear

guide.title: Li Li's Synergies and Counters
guide.text:
Li Li synergizes with
Li Li does very well with Heroes who can mitigate burst damage on their own
because it allows her to succeed against burst damage, where she otherwise struggles.
That said, this is not a concern when facing team compositions that lack
burst damage altogether.
While not really a synergy, Li Li also does well with Heroes who have strong waveclear
as she is not able to directly contribute to macro pressure in a meaningful way.
Last but not the least, Li Li does not have access to hard crowd control effects,
therefore she will perform way better when paired with Heroes who can provide it.
Considering how her Abilities and Talents work, Li Li is pretty interesting
to play together with a burst Healer,
but make sure to still have a well-rounded team composition when doing so.
Li Li is countered by
Healing Brew is not very effective against burst damage
because it does not heal that much and has a relatively slow animation.
Li Li is also countered by crowd control
that can interrupt her Heroic Abilities.

guide.title: Li Li's Maps
guide.text:
Li Li's stronger maps
Li Li's average maps
Li Li's weaker maps
Li Li's viability is not relative to the environment, but to
the Heroes on either team, especially in the enemy one. While she performs consistently on most Maps,
she tends to do slightly better where team fights take longer as she can get
more value from her sustain healing,
especially if accompanied by another Healer or just a Support,
and slightly worse on Maps where waveclear is important.

guide.title: Li Li's Tips and Tricks
guide.text:
Sometimes Healing Brew requires you to position near who you want to heal because they are in danger and far from who you do not want to heal because they are already safe.
Due to its short Attack Range while active, Cloud Serpent should be used on frontline Heroes as they engage.
Use Blinding Wind only when enemy Heroes step up for doing damage because the Blind is relatively short.
Do not cast Jug of 1,000 Cups too late during team fights, but use it to top off your team, because it is pretty slow at healing.
When safe to do so, intentionally take a small amount of damage to activate Fast Feet for a few seconds, then repeat if possible.
See our Abilities page for further information »

guide.title: Li Li's Role in the Current Meta
guide.text:
Li Li is very effective in prolonged team fights, where her sustain
healing has time to accumulate into a substantial Health advantage for her
team. On the other hand, she cannot do much against burst damage.
While she is capable of functioning as the only Healer for her team,
however, she can be played as Support alongside another Healer with success
by changing some Talents to increase her damage output and utility.

abilities.title: Li Li's Tips and Tricks
abilities.text:
Sometimes Healing Brew requires you to position near who you want to heal because they are in danger and far from who you do not want to heal because they are already safe.
Due to its short Attack Range while active, Cloud Serpent should be used on frontline Heroes as they engage.
Use Blinding Wind only when enemy Heroes step up for doing damage because the Blind is relatively short.
Do not cast Jug of 1,000 Cups too late during team fights, but use it to top off your team, because it is pretty slow at healing.
When safe to do so, intentionally take a small amount of damage to activate Fast Feet for a few seconds, then repeat if possible.

abilities.title: Healing Brew
abilities.text:
Healing Brew
(Q)
Li Li
Mana: 25
Cooldown: 4 seconds
Heal the lowest Health allied Hero within 6 range for 210 (+4% per level) Health.
Healing Brew is a Basic Ability that, after a short but noticeable travel time,
heals the allied Hero who has the lowest percentage of Health within range,
marked with a blue circle under their Hero model.
The corresponding icon is grey when there are no valid targets nearby.
When multiple allied Heroes have about the same percentage of Health and you want to choose who to heal,
you can position Li Li in a way that only one of them will be in range. Unfortunately,
the healing will always target Li Li when she has the lowest percentage of Health within range.
If you want to maximize your casting speed and there are no other valid targets nearby
that you could target by mistake with a wrong position, you can hold down [Q]
to instantly cast Healing Brew on your desired target when it comes off of cooldown.

abilities.title: Cloud Serpent
abilities.text:
Cloud Serpent
(W)
Li Li
Mana: 35
Cooldown: 11 seconds
Summon a Cloud Serpent on an allied Hero that attacks nearby enemies every second. Each attack deals 26 (+4% per level) damage and heals the ally for 20 (+4% per level). Lasts for 8 seconds.
Cloud Serpent is a Basic Ability that summons a Cloud Serpent
to assist an allied Hero—or even Li Li herself—with damage and healing for 8 seconds.
Cast it on allied Heroes who are within range of enemies or who are about to engage.
As a rule of thumb that will help you avoid wasting Mana, only cast this Ability
when the target allied Hero is in danger or will stay near an enemy for at least 4 seconds.
When more than two enemy Heroes are within range of this Ability but you want to hit
a particular Hero among them, you can position Li Li in a way that only two of them will be in range.
Remember that the effect will always hit Heroes over non-Heroes.

abilities.title: Blinding Winds
abilities.text:
Blinding Wind
(E)
Li Li
Mana: 30
Cooldown: 12 seconds
Throw a cloud of wind at the 2 nearest enemies (prioritizing Heroes), dealing 133 (+4% per level) damage. Heroes hit are Blinded and Slowed by 15% for 1.5 seconds.
Blinding Wind is a Basic Ability that simultaneously damages enemies,
reduces the damage that they can deal by Blinding them,
and Slows them.
The corresponding icon is grey when there are no valid targets nearby.
While it can be used both offensively and defensively, try to use it defensively
most of the time. The Blind effect provided can be a lifesaver
for your team, especially against enemy Heroes who deal a lot of damage with
Basic Attacks (for example The Butcher). Use it for dealing damage
only when you can secure a kill.
We recommend not using it on Minions because it does relatively low damage,
it costs a considerable amount of Mana, and has a long cooldown that should be saved
for use against Heroes.

abilities.title: Jug of 1,000 Cups
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Jug of 1,000 Cups
(R)
Li Li
Heroic
Mana: 80
Cooldown: 20 seconds
Channel for up to 6 seconds. Every 0.25 seconds, increase the cooldown of Jug of 1,000 Cups by 2 seconds, up to 50 additional seconds, and heal the lowest Health nearby allied Hero for 75 (+4% per level) Health.
Jug of 1,000 Cups is a Heroic Ability which provides
a massive amount of healing for you and your team. While it looks as an
area of effect Ability, its healing output is the same
regardless of how many allied Heroes are within range. As a consequence,
you can use it to save a single allied Hero without fear.
The corresponding icon is grey when there are no valid targets nearby.
Due to the short delay between the key press and the delivery of the first heal
and the fact that the healing happens over 6 seconds, it is important to cast this
Heroic Ability pre-emptively when you think an allied Hero is going to need it.
Considering the moderately long channel time, it is recommended to cast
all your Basic Abilities before using this Heroic Ability because their cooldown
will progress in the meanwhile.
Be careful when you use it because, being a channeled Ability,
it can be interrupted by most crowd control effects.
The range is long enough that you can stay safe in the backline
during team fights and still be able to heal your frontline.
If you do not need its effect anymore, you can press [R] again to cancel it.
Whether its channeling gets
interrupted by yourself this way or by the enemy
via ccrowd control effects, its total cooldown of 70 seconds will be reduced
based on how many seconds of channel were remaining.
Each second of unused channel
is worth 8 seconds of cooldown reduction, with a limit of 50 seconds.
The cooldown starts as soon as you begin channeling and cannot be higher than
64 seconds—in case of full channel—or lower than 20 seconds—in
case of immediate interrupt.
The targeting mechanic of this Heroic Ability works like Healing Brew.
When multiple allied Heroes have about the same percentage of Health and you want to choose who to heal,
you can position Li Li in a way that only one of them will be in range. Unfortunately,
the healing will always target Li Li when she has the lowest percentage of Health within range.

abilities.title: Water Dragon
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Water Dragon
(R)
Li Li
Heroic
Mana: 60
Cooldown: 50 seconds
Li Li channels for 2 seconds, summoning a Water Dragon that hits the nearest enemy Hero within 12 range and all enemies near them, dealing 300 (+4% per level) damage and slowing their Movement Speed by 70% for 4 seconds.
Water Dragon is a Heroic Ability that, after 2 seconds
of channel, damages and Slows the nearest
enemy Hero within range and all enemies around them.
The corresponding icon is grey when there are no valid targets nearby.
While the damage is high enough to make the difference and secure a kill,
what makes this Ability strong is the powerful and long lasting Slow
that will work as a form of engage or peel
for your team.

abilities.title: Fast Feet
abilities.text:
Fast Feet
(D)
Li Li
Upon taking damage, your Basic Ability cooldowns refresh 50% faster and you gain 10% Movement Speed for 1 second.
Fast Feet is a Trait that gives Li Li cooldown reduction
and Movement Speed when she takes damage, increasing her healing output and
making her very hard to kill without burst damage and
crowd control.
To keep this effect active, try to take
a small amount of damage (for example walking into Psionic Storm
by Tassadar for a brief moment) whenever you can safely do so.

talent_pages.text:

Free Drinks
(Level 1)
Li Li
When Healing Brew heals a Hero under 50% Health, its cooldown is reduced by 1 second, and its Mana cost is refunded.
Free Drinks is a good Talent that, when
Healing Brew heals an allied Hero
that has less than 50% maximum Health, reduces its cooldown
and refunds its Mana cost.
Pick this Talent when you want to be as little dependent
on Fast Feet as possible for safety reasons because,
contrary to the other options in the same Tier, Free Drinks
does not require you to take damage in order to work.
While we find this Talent interesting regardless of your Build,
it has synergy with other Healing Brew-based Talents:
The Good Stuff at Level 7, Two For One at Level 16,
and Pick Me Up at Level 16 as well.
?
Serpent Sidekick
(Level 1)
Li Li
Cloud Serpent no longer costs Mana and while Fast Feet is active its cooldown refreshes an additional 75% faster.
Serpent Sidekick is a good Talent that completely removes
the Mana cost of Cloud Serpent and increases the cooldown refresh rate bonus
that it gets while Fast Feet is active.
When you have this Talent, keep in mind that each Hero can have only one Cloud Serpent
active on them and therefore you should usually swap targets when using it again. The only time this rule won't
apply is if you really want to refresh it on a specific Hero because they will move too far from you and/or
because it will get more value than on others.
As they obviously benefit from the cooldown reduction it provides,
consider picking this Talent only if you plan to pick multiple
Cloud Serpent-based Talents later on:
Wind Serpent at Level 4,
Lightning Serpent at Level 13,
and Blessings Of Yu'lon at Level 16.
?
Eager Adventurer
(Level 1)
Li Li
Increase Fast Feet's duration by 150% and increase Mana regeneration by 150% while Fast Feet is active.
Eager Adventurer is a decent Talent that
makes Fast Feet last longer
and increases your Mana Regeneration while your Trait is active.
The increased duration helps you keep Fast Feet active
for longer while taking damage less often, making it way easier to keep your Trait active.

talent_pages.title: Level 4 Talents for Li Li
talent_pages.text:
?
Wind Serpent
(Level 4)
Li Li
Cloud Serpent grants its bearer 10% increased Movement Speed. Casting Blinding Wind increases this bonus to 20% for 3 seconds.
Passive: Cloud Serpent attacks 25% faster.
Wind Serpent is a good Talent that you can use
to increase the Movement Speed of allied Heroes while casting Cloud Serpent on them.
You can further increase the Movement Speed provided by casting Blinding Wind.
In additon to that, each summoned Cloud Serpent will have slightly more Attack Speed,
resulting in 2 additional Basic Attacks, going from a maximum of 8 to a maximum of 10 Basic Attacks.
Thanks to the Attack Speed provided to your Cloud Serpents, this Talent has synergy with:
Lightning Serpent at Level 13, and Blessings Of Yu'lon at Level 16.
As a consequence, you will be able to get around 25% more value from those Talents.
If you pick Wind Serpent in conjunction with Serpent Sidekick
at Level 1 and/or Shake It Off at Level 20, you should usually avoid
casting Cloud Serpent on the same Hero for two times in a row,
else you will end up overriding the previous Could Serpent and thus waste some value.
✔
Surging Winds
(Level 4)
Li Li
If Blinding Wind targets 2 or more Heroes, its cooldown is instantly reduced by 2 seconds and Li Li gains 10% Spell Power for 10 seconds.
Surging Winds is a good Talent that,
after hitting 2 enemy Heroes with Blinding Wind,
slightly reduces its cooldown and gives you Spell Power,
increasing both your damage and healing output for a few seconds.
While the cooldown reduction is not that relevant, the Spell Power provided basically empowers
any aspect of your kit, including damage and healing done via Heroic Abilities and Talents:
Lightning Serpent at Level 13 and Blessings Of Yu'lon at Level 16.
Make sure to meet the condition of hitting 2 Heroes with Blinding Wind
by waiting for 2 enemy Heroes to be within 7 range before casting it,
else you will get almost no value from this Talent. The UI will does not have
any indicator to tell you if this condition is being met or not.
?
Safety Sprint
(Level 4)
Li Li
Activate to gain Fast Feet, 30 Armor, and 30% Movement Speed for 3 seconds.
Passive: While Fast Feet is active, Li Li gains 10 Armor.
Safety Sprint is a situational Talent that gives you Armor
while Fast Feet is active and allows you to manually activate it
to gain even more Armor and Movement Speed.
You may need this Talent when playing around burst damage
and/or dive Heroes to heavily increase your survivability
when being focused down by the enemy team.
You can combine it with Eager Adventurer at Level 1 for extra value
as they amplify each other: more Fast Feet uptime
means more 10 Armor uptime and having Armor helps you mantain
your Trait active while taking less damage in return.

(Level 7)
Li Li
Increase the number of enemies hit by Blinding Wind from 2 to 3. Blinding Wind deals 75% more damage when it targets 3 Heroes.
Mass Vortex is a good Talent that allows you to hit 1 additional Hero
with each cast of Blinding Wind and, when hitting only Heroes with it,
deal bonus damage to them.
When using this Talent, in order to meet its condition to deal bonus damage,
all you need to do is try to have 3 Heroes within 7 range before casting Blinding Wind.
Put your mouse cursor on its icon to check how big it is and remember it while playing.
Keep in mind that the bonus damage does not happen if you hit less than 3 Heroes.
The increased number of targets has synergy with Gale Force
and especially Hindering Winds at Level 13,
but notice that you can pick only one of them as they are on the same Tier.
You can also pair it with Surging Winds at Level 4
as it helps you cast Blinding Wind a bit more often.
✔
Let's Go!
(Level 7)
Li Li
Cooldown: 40 seconds
Activate to heal an allied Hero for 160 (+4% per level) and make them Unstoppable for 1 second. Let's Go's cooldown is affected by Fast Feet.
Cannot be used on Li Li.
Let's Go! is a strong Talent that you can activate
to make a target allied Hero (other than yourself) within 7.5 range
Unstoppable for a second and heal them for a small amount.
The cooldown of this Ability is 40 seconds and can be reduced via Fast Feet.
Li Li can also activate Let's Go!
while channeling any Heroic Ability.
We recommend picking this Talent when the enemy team relies on crowd control
and burst damage paired together to take down Heroes and win team fights
because Li Li does not have better tools than this to deal with this kind of threat.

talent_pages.title: Level 10 Talents for Li Li
talent_pages.text:
In this section we discuss when and why to pick a given Heroic Ability.
If you want to read how they work in detail and/or you are looking for some tips on how to use them,
check them out on the Abilities and Strategy page.
✔
Jug of 1,000 Cups
(Level 10)
Li Li
Mana: 80
Cooldown: 20 seconds
Channel for up to 6 seconds. Every 0.25 seconds, increase the cooldown of Jug of 1,000 Cups by 2 seconds, up to 50 additional seconds, and heal the lowest Health nearby allied Hero for 75 (+4% per level) Health.
Jug of 1,000 Cups is a strong Heroic Ability that provides
a massive amount of healing for you and your team, which is great to save
whoever is being targeted by enemy Heroes, if you manage to cast it in time
and you do not get interrupted.
When you are the only Healer in your team,
you should heavily prefer this Heroic Ability, unless the enemy team
has tools to reliably interrupt it.
When paired with another Healer, you have to
check if your team has enough healing and/or enough damage
and then choose which Heroic Ability is more useful.
?
Water Dragon
(Level 10)
Li Li
Mana: 60
Cooldown: 50 seconds
Li Li channels for 2 seconds, summoning a Water Dragon that hits the nearest enemy Hero within 12 range and all enemies near them, dealing 300 (+4% per level) damage and slowing their Movement Speed by 70% for 4 seconds.
Water Dragon is a good Heroic Ability that gives
you access to a powerful Slow, useful to
crowd control enemy Heroes that lack mobility.
While it can be outranged before actually hitting, it cannot be interrupted.
Pick this Heroic Ability when your team needs more damage, crowd control,
when Jug of 1,000 Cups can be interrupted with ease,
and/or simply because you want more playmaking potential at the cost of raw healing.

talent_pages.title: Level 13 Talents for Li Li
talent_pages.text:
?
Lightning Serpent
(Level 13)
Li Li
Cloud Serpent attacks bounce to hit 2 additional targets for 13 (+4% per level) damage and 10 (+4% per level) healing.
Lightning Serpent is a good Talent that empowers the
Basic Attacks of your Cloud Serpents by making them bounce from an enemy to another,
for a total of 3 enemies hit at most. Each bounce will increase the healing
done from Cloud Serpent by 50%, up to 100% when hitting 3 enemies.
Pick this Talent when you want to further increase your sustain healing,
especially if you have Wind Serpent at Level 4
and/or Blessings Of Yu'lon at Level 16
because they make it more powerful.
✔
Gale Force
(Level 13)
Li Li
Increase Blinding Wind's Blind duration by 0.75 seconds. Li Li's Basic Attacks against Blinded Heroes deal 100% increased damage.
Gale Force is a good Talent that enhances
Blinding Wind in 2 ways:
first of all, the Blind it provides will last slightly longer,
basically denying one additional Basic Attack per Hero hit;
secondly, it will make you deal way more Attack Damage to enemy Heroes
affected by Blinds, even if they have been applied by allied Heroes!
Pick this Talent when you are facing Heroes who focus on Basic Attacks to deal damage
and/or to increase your own damage on whoever is getting focused down by your team
and help them to quickly secure the kill.
?
Hindering Winds
(Level 13)
Li Li
Increase Blinding Wind's Slow amount to 30% and its duration to 2 seconds.
Hindering Winds is a decent Talent that empowers the Slow
applied via Blinding Wind by increasing both its amount and duration.
The duration of the Blind is not increased by this Talent.
We find this Talent particularly useful as a form of peeling
from enemy Heroes that lack mobility in their kit,
so that allied Heroes can easily outrange them.

talent_pages.title: Level 16 Talents for Li Li
talent_pages.text:
✔
Two For One
(Level 16)
Li Li
Increases the number of allies healed by Healing Brew to 2, but increases the cooldown by 1 second.
Two For One is a strong Talent that allows you to heal
up to 2 allied Heroes with each cast of Healing Brew
at the cost of having a slightly longer cooldown.
The ability to heal 2 targets at the same time will drastically increase
the sustain healing you can provide to your team when facing Heroes
who can deal a lot of poke damage
spread on multiple targets (such as Lunara).
?
Pick Me Up
(Level 16)
Li Li
Healing Brew heals for 33% more when the target is under 50% Health.
Pick Me Up is a good Talent that increases the single-target healing of
Healing Brew when it counts the most. Whenever an ally is low
on Health, this Talent will give bonus healing to the recipient.
We recommend picking this Talent when facing burst damage
because it will help you save allied Heroes who are almost dead.
?
Blessings Of Yu'lon
(Level 16)
Li Li
Cloud Serpent grants its bearer 10% increased healing received and heals them for an additional 0.5% of their maximum Health each time it attacks.
Blessings Of Yu'lon is a strong Talent
that makes Cloud Serpent heal more,
based on the targeted allied Hero's maximum Health, and empower the healing they receive from any source.
Pick this Talent in conjunction with other Cloud Serpent-based Talents
to get the most value out of it, especially if your team has multiple Heroes with high maximum Health.

talent_pages.title: Level 20 Talents for Li Li
talent_pages.text:
✔
Jug of 1,000,000 Cups
(Level 20)
Li Li
Jug of 1,000 Cups heals two allies at a time.
Jug of 1,000,000 Cups is a strong Talent that doubles the healing you can do
with Jug of 1,000 Cups by increasing the number of targets from 1 to 2.
Keep in mind that this Talent will not increase your healing output on a single target,
but only make it work on two targets at the same time. If you want to empower your single target healing,
your only option in this Tier is Mistweaver,
a versatile Talent that also provides good area of effect healing.
Pick this Talent when you need to heal two allied Heroes at the same time,
so usually against Heroes who can constantly deal a lot of poke damage
spread on multiple Heroes (for example Azmodan).
?
Double Dragon
(Level 20)
Li Li
After hitting a target with Water Dragon, another Water Dragon is summoned at the point of impact.
Double Dragon is a good Talent that doubles the effect of
Water Dragon by summoning a second one right after the first.
Pick this Talent when you want more crowd control
and/or damage to help your team secure kills,
especially if you are playing as secondary Healer.
?
Mistweaver
(Level 20)
Li Li
Cooldown: 30 seconds
Activate to heal nearby allied Heroes for 149 (+4% per level). Basic Attacks and Cloud Serpent attacks reduce the cooldown of Mistweaver by 1 second.
Mistweaver is a good Talent that,
on a short cooldown which can also be reduced with Basic Attacks done
by you and your Cloud Serpent, can be activated to heal all Heroes within range.
Contrary to the majority of Active Talents, Mistweaver can be activated
while channeling any Heroic Ability.
Even if not that much, this Talent can help Li Li to deal with burst damage,
something she otherwise struggles to mitigate. Do not hesitate to use it for healing a single target
if they are in danger.
?
Shake It Off
(Level 20)
Li Li
While Stunned, Silenced, or Rooted and for 2 seconds afterwards, Li Li gains 35 Armor.
Passive: Increase Fast Feet's cooldown refresh rate to 75%.
Shake It Off is a situational Talent that
passively increases the cooldown refresh rate bonus you get from Fast Feet
and makes Li Li harder to kill when hit by some crowd control
effects—Stun, Silence, and Root—by
giving her a considerable amount of Armor while affected by them
and for a few seconds after.
You can combine Shake It Off with Eager Adventurer at Level 1
to get more value from its cooldown reduction component, otherwise
pick this Talent only if you have a hard time surviving in the late game
against a team composition featuring crowd control effects
that can easily hit you.
